summary: Iteration 62 (today 2026-11-12) tested 3 features: (1) marking the bolli F24 as paid (versato), with a prima nota entry and the quarter shown as closed; (2) the bolli deadline on the dashboard with a 'Prepara F24' button; (3) deleting prima nota entries except for SDI-accepted documents and Ri.Ba. Backend: 17/17 new pytest tests pass. Checked: GET /api/bolli returns key/versato/concluso. The dashboard window contains BOL-2026-2 (scaduta) and BOL-2026-3 (prossima), with codice 252x, importo, trimestre and anno; Q1 (out of window) and Q4 (current quarter) are not listed. POST versato returns 400 'provvisorio' for Q4, 404 for an empty quarter, 422 for a bad key or date, and 403 for operatore. It works for the old Q1 outside the dashboard window. It creates exactly one GE entry with origine 'bolli': Dare 30.14.002 / Avere 06.01.001 for 2,00. Re-posting replaces the entry and does not duplicate it. A paid quarter whose deadline has passed disappears from the dashboard; a future one shows stato 'versato'. DELETE versato removes the record and the entry (a second call returns 404). A closed year blocks annulla and del_reg. del_reg: vendita returns 400 when the invoice is consegnata or mancata_consegna and 200 when it is inviata. Acquisto returns 400 for sdi_simulato and 200 for upload. riba, riba_scadenza and riba_insoluto return 400. banca, liquidazione, importazione and manuale return 200, and a later GET returns 404. Side effects work: pagamenti deletes the distinta and its passive_payments; ritenute and bolli delete f24_versamenti; saldaconto payments linked by coge_entry_id are removed. A closed year returns 400; operatore gets 403; an unknown id gets 404. Regression: iteration 60 and 61 suites pass after updating 1 outdated iteration 60 assertion (scadenze are now shifted to working days). UI (desktop): the dashboard panel shows the 'Imposta di bollo' rows with amount and 'Prepara F24', which downloads F24_bolli_2026_T3.pdf; Versato and annulla work. On /bolli-virtuali, bolli-data/bolli-segna appear only on concluded quarters (Q1–Q3, not Q4). After marking, the card shows 'Versato il 01/06/2026 · trimestre chiuso' and the Prepara F24 button is hidden; annulla (with confirm) brings it back. Prima nota: reg-delete is shown for every entry except riba. The confirm texts are specific (bolli: 'Il trimestre dei bolli tornerà da versare'). The SDI error toast appears for a consegnata invoice. Deleting the bolli entry sets the quarter back to 'da versare'. Found and fixed 1 bug: the global FiscalBanner labelled bolli alerts as 'ritenute'.

ui_bugs.issue: Bolli alerts were labelled 'ritenute' ('F24 2522 ritenute 2° trimestre 2026...'). FIXED by tester: now shows 'imposta di bollo'.

issues: The action column ('Prepara F24' / 'Versato') is cut off at the right edge; you only reach it by scrolling the table sideways. Consider stacking the buttons under the row on mobile.
'1 bolli' is wrong grammar; use 'bollo' when n == 1.
bolli-data-{q} uses the native <input type=date> instead of the shadcn calendar (consistent with the rest of the app, minor).

reg-delete is shown on vendita/acquisto entries of SDI-accepted documents, but the delete always fails with a toast. Consider hiding or disabling it (needs the invoice status/origine in the list). The vendita confirm says 'potrai ricrearla con Rigenera', but Rigenera only re-registers consegnata/mancata_consegna invoices, which are exactly the ones that cannot be deleted. Deletable vendita entries (invoice inviata/bozza) would NOT be recreated.

action_items: Optional: mobile layout of the ScadenzeFiscaliPanel action buttons
Optional: singular 'bollo' in periodo_label; fix the Rigenera hint in the vendita delete confirm; hide reg-delete for SDI-accepted docs
critical_code_review_comments: del_reg allows deleting 'apertura' entries (and 'chiusura' when the year is not in coge_chiusi). Deleting an apertura entry of an open year silently breaks the opening balances. Consider blocking apertura/chiusura (they are managed from Chiusura esercizio).
del_reg on origine 'liquidazione' only deletes the entry. If the liquidazioni module keeps state linked to the entry (contabilita_chiusure /liquidazioni), check that it does not become inconsistent.
segna_versato accepts any data (future, or before quarter end). Consider requiring data >= quarter end.
Dashboard 'Versato' always uses today's date (no date picker), unlike the bolli card. Acceptable but inconsistent.
annulla_versato for IVA keys calls coge.annulla(..., 'ritenute', key). Harmless no-op, but misleading.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows (1 label bug fixed)
